title: Dual Realms of Consciousness
description: A surreal split composition featuring a large green robotic head with glowing cyan eyes and a third eye in the top half, overlooking an elderly couple sitting at a table in a domestic room. The bottom half shows a happy green slime creature with a wide smile emerging from glowing water, surrounded by colorful concentric circles, a black sun eclipse, and distant mountains.
